#  11231 - Pre Professional Training and European Language Skills Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **11231 - module is no longer offered from WS 2024/25**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Pre Professional Training and European Language Skills**  |  
|  Berufsvorbereitendes Training und europäische Sprachen   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 2 - Environment and Natural Sciences   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. PD Dr.-Ing. habil. Molkenthin, Frank 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every winter semester   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | Pre professional training: 
  * Preparedness to professional work, professional oriented presentation and documentation skills, identification of professional oriented master thesis topics.

European Language skills (except English).  |  
| Contents:  | Pre professional training:
  * Professional projects: typical working steps in professional projects, project application and documentation, literature and case study review, software packages for professional project application (commercial and open source), project oriented software adaptation concepts.


  * Seminars with professional experts on selected topics.


  * Presentation of professional projects from EuroAquae and external partners (e.g. GFZ, PIK, DHI, DHI-Wasy, Jacobs, Wallingford, Suez Environment, Ingenieurbüro Sieker) in seminars, identification of Master Thesis topics for Semester 4.

European Language skills:
  * German Language course, optional courses on other European languages except English

 |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | Basic skills in hydroengineering and hydroinformatics  |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | No successful participation in associated phase-out module _41510 Pre Professional Training_.  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Lecture / 2 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Seminar / 2 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Practical training / 4 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 60 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | see https://euroaquae.tu-cottbus.de  |  
| Module Examination:  | Continuous Assessment (MCA)  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | Partial organized by Nice University Sophia-Antipolis.Pre professional training:
  * Assignment and presentation assessment

European Language skills:
  * Assessment/ examination mode of the related language course

The module is offered and assessed in cooperation with Nice University Sophia-Antipolis/F and the other EuroAquae partner universities.  |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Remarks:  | Offered in cooperation with Nice University Sophia-Antipolis/F and other EuroAquae partner universities.EuroAquae module: EA-3.Y Option 1  |  
| Module Components:  | Organized in cooperation with Nice University Sophia-Antipolis partial by online seminars.  |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment

 |
